blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 214 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 26, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DRX & REGN lead 214 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 57 Canadian and 157 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 26, 2026) found 214 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 57 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 11 of them new to the list this week. ADF Group Inc. (DRX) leads with a +105% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 11 names.

In the U.S., 157 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 57 of them new to the list this week. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc. (REGN) leads with a +64% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 31 names.
